## Database Implementation (Momen Auto-Generated)

The backend database for Ascent was generated using Momen AI based on the system requirements.

### Generated Tables:
- account (users)
- organization
- opportunity
- soft_skill
- opportunity_skill_assignment
- comment
- comment_report
- watchlist_item

### Key Relationships:
- Users = Comments, Reports, Watchlist
- Organizations = Opportunities
- Opportunities = Soft Skills, Comments
- Comments = Reports + Replies

### Purpose:
This schema supports:
- Opportunity search and filtering
- Trust verification system
- Community commenting and moderation
- AI-based recommendations
- User watchlists and tracking

# Recommendation Flow (AI System Design)

## Purpose
Generate ranked opportunity recommendations using AI.

## Flow
1. Fetch user by user_id
2. Fetch all opportunities
3. Send both datasets to AI Core agent
4. AI ranks opportunities based on relevance
5. Return top 5 results

## Inputs
- user_id (Number)

## Outputs
- ranked opportunities
- explanation per match

## Notes
- Uses asynchronous AI execution
- No pre-filtering applied before AI
- Ranking fully handled by AI model
